messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hi there — I’m trying to change the email address on my account because I recently updated my email. Can you help me update it?

{"message":"I can help with that. To update your email I first need to verify your identity. Please provide one of the following so I can look up your account: your current Rho‑Bank email, your user ID, or your full name (case‑sensitive). Also tell me the new email address you want on the account. After I locate your account I’ll ask you to confirm any 2 of these: date of birth, email, phone number, or address. Is that okay?"}

Sure. My full name is **Kenji Tanaka** (case-sensitive: Kenji Tanaka), and the current email on my account is **kenji.tanaka@gmail.com**.

The new email I want to use is: **kenji.tanaka@outlook.com**.

Found 1 record(s) in 'users':

1. Record ID: 6680a37184
   name: Kenji Tanaka
   user_id: 6680a37184
   address: 1847 Cherry Blossom Lane, Seattle, WA 98101
   email: kenji.tanaka@outlook.com
   phone_number: 206-555-0293
   date_of_birth: 07/22/1985

{"message":"Thanks — I can help. To update your email I first need to verify your identity. Please confirm any 2 of the following (do not include more than you’re comfortable sharing):

- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Current email on the account
- Phone number on the account
- Mailing address on the account

Also please confirm the new email you want set (you wrote kenji.tanaka@outlook.com). Once you provide two matching fields I will log the verification and proceed with the change. If you’d rather speak to a human instead, tell me and I’ll transfer you."}

You can verify me with these two:

- Current email on the account: **kenji.tanaka@gmail.com**  
- Phone number on the account: **206-555-0293**

And yes, please set my new email to **kenji.tanaka@outlook.com**.

{"message":"Thanks — I checked and your phone number (206-555-0293) matches our record, but the email you gave (kenji.tanaka@gmail.com) does not. I also couldn’t find an account using that gmail address. I can’t proceed with the change until you verify 2 of the 4 fields. Please provide one of the following so I have two matching fields to verify:

- Date of birth (MM/DD/YYYY)
- Mailing address (street address)

You’ve already asked to set the new email to kenji.tanaka@outlook.com — I’ll use that once verification succeeds. If you’d rather speak with a human instead, tell me and I’ll transfer you."}

That’s strange — I’m absolutely sure my current email is **kenji.tanaka@gmail.com**.

I don’t have my date of birth or mailing address handy right now. Can you please transfer me to a human who can help sort this out?

# Internal: Human Agent Transfer Reason Codes

## Overview

When using the transfer_to_human_agents tool, select the most accurate reason code from the tiered list below. Reasons are organized into 4 priority tiers - always select from the highest tier that applies.

## TIER 1 (HIGHEST PRIORITY) - Specific Functional/Operational Reasons

Use these when a specific operational scenario applies:

| Reason Code | When to Use |
|-------------|-------------|
| fraud_or_security_concern | Fraud, identity theft, unauthorized transactions, or security concerns requiring specialist handling |
| account_closure_request | Customer is explicitly requesting to close their account |
| deceased_account_holder | Customer needs to report a deceased account holder or handle estate matters |
| legal_or_regulatory_matter | Subpoena, court order, garnishment, or compliance-related inquiry |
| account_ownership_dispute | Ownership disputes, joint account issues, or identity verification failures requiring specialist |
| complex_billing_dispute | Billing disputes requiring specialist review (recurring charges, statement errors, fee reversals) |
| abusive_customer_behavior | Customer is being abusive, threatening, or using inappropriate language |
| third_party_inquiry | Attorney, power of attorney, or authorized representative inquiry requiring verification |
| technical_system_error | System error or outage preventing completion of the customer's request |
